items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee responds to the interviewer's questions about Posey ('Yeah. Uh-huh.', 'Yeah.', 'Very seldom.') but does not describe a personal relationship, collaboration, or direct interaction with Posey.

ctx.x: Yeah. He had a beautiful tone. A beautiful tone. I liked it.
Well, Posey, of course, he was just play acting all the time, wasn't he?
